```{python}
#| include: false
import os
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.ticker import PercentFormatter

DIR_FILE = Path.cwd()
ROOT_DIR = os.path.dirname(DIR_FILE)
DATASET_PATH = os.path.join(
    ROOT_DIR, "dataset", "credit_card_fraud_detection_2026.csv")
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)

n_total = len(df)
n_fraud = int(df["is_fraud"].sum())
baseline = n_fraud / n_total
fraud_data = df.loc[df["is_fraud"] == 1]

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
plt.rcParams["axes.spines.top"] = False
plt.rcParams["axes.spines.right"] = False

def bullets(*lines):
    print("\n".join(f"- {l}" for l in lines))

def wilson(k, n, z=1.96):
    p = k / n
    d = 1 + z**2 / n
    c = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / d
    h = z * np.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / d
    return c - h, c + h

def rate_table(data, col, min_n=500):
    g = (data.groupby(col)
         .agg(n=("is_fraud", "size"), fraud=("is_fraud", "sum"))
         .reset_index())
    g = g[g["n"] >= min_n].copy()
    g["rate"] = g["fraud"] / g["n"]
    g["lift"] = g["rate"] / baseline
    g["lo"], g["hi"] = wilson(g["fraud"], g["n"])
    return g

def plot_rate(g, col, title, figsize=(7, 4), fs=10):
    g = g.sort_values("rate", ascending=False)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    sns.barplot(data=g, y=col, x="rate", order=g[col].tolist(),
                color="#4C72B0", ax=ax)
    ax.errorbar(g["rate"].values, np.arange(len(g)),
                xerr=[(g["rate"] - g["lo"]).values,
                      (g["hi"] - g["rate"]).values],
                fmt="none", ecolor="black", capsize=2, lw=1)
    ax.axvline(baseline, ls="--", color="#C44E52",
               label=f"Baseline {baseline:.2%}")
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1, decimals=1))
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=fs)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Fraud Rate (95% CI)")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    ax.legend(frameon=False)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## Distribution of Fraud
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
counts = df["is_fraud"].value_counts().sort_index()
labels = ["Non-Fraud", "Fraud"]
pct = counts / counts.sum() * 100

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
bars = ax.bar(labels, counts.values, color=["#4C72B0", "#C44E52"])
for bar, n, p in zip(bars, counts.values, pct.values):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height(),
            f"{n:,}\n({p:.2f}%)", ha="center", va="bottom")
ax.set_title("Distribusi Fraud")
ax.set_ylabel("Jumlah transaksi")
ax.set_ylim(0, counts.max() * 1.15)
plt.show()
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
bullets(
    "Data sangat imbalanced.",
    f"Fraud hanya **{baseline:.2%}** ({n_fraud:,} dari {n_total:,}).",
    "Angka ini jadi baseline di slide berikutnya.",
)
```
:::
::: {.notes}
- Baseline dipakai untuk menghitung lift tiap segmen

## Amount Distribution
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
loss = fraud_data["fraud_amount_lost"]
median_loss = loss.median()
p75_loss = loss.quantile(0.75)
hv, edges = np.histogram(loss, bins=40)
peak = (edges[hv.argmax()] + edges[hv.argmax() + 1]) / 2

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
sns.histplot(data=fraud_data, x="fraud_amount_lost", bins=40, kde=True,
             color="#E76F51", edgecolor="white", alpha=0.8, ax=ax)
ax.axvline(peak, color="#2A9D8F", ls="--", lw=2,
           label=f"Peak: ${peak:,.0f}")
ax.axvline(median_loss, color="#264653", ls="-.", lw=2,
           label=f"Median: ${median_loss:,.0f}")
ax.axvline(p75_loss, color="#FF392E", ls="--", lw=2,
           label=f"P75: ${p75_loss:,.0f}")
ax.set_title("Distribution of Fraud Amount Lost")
ax.set_xlabel("Fraud Amount Lost ($)")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Fraud Transactions")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
bullets(
    f"Total kerugian **\\${loss.sum():,.0f}**.",
    f"Puncak distribusi sekitar \\${peak:,.0f}, median \\${median_loss:,.0f}.",
    f"Kerugian terbesar \\${loss.max():,.0f}.",
    "Rata-rata > median: distribusi miring ke kanan.",
)
```

## Transaction Amount: Fraud vs Non-Fraud
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
plot_df = df.assign(kelas=df["is_fraud"].map({0: "Non-Fraud", 1: "Fraud"}))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
sns.boxplot(data=plot_df, x="kelas", y="transaction_amount",
            order=["Non-Fraud", "Fraud"], log_scale=True,
            palette=["#4C72B0", "#C44E52"], hue="kelas", legend=False,
            ax=ax)
ax.set_title("Transaction Amount by Class (log scale)")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_ylabel("Amount ($, log)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
med = df.groupby("is_fraud")["transaction_amount"].median()
bullets(
    f"Median non-fraud \\${med[0]:,.2f}.",
    f"Median fraud \\${med[1]:,.2f} ({med[1] / med[0]:.1f}x).",
)
```
:::

## Fraud Rate by Hour
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
g = rate_table(df, "transaction_hour")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.plot(g["transaction_hour"], g["rate"], marker="o", color="#4C72B0")
ax.fill_between(g["transaction_hour"], g["lo"], g["hi"], alpha=0.2)
ax.axhline(baseline, ls="--", color="#C44E52",
           label=f"Baseline {baseline:.2%}")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1, decimals=1))
ax.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax.set_title("Fraud Rate by Hour of Day")
ax.set_xlabel("Hour")
ax.set_ylabel("Fraud Rate (95% CI)")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
top3 = g.nlargest(3, "rate")
bullets(
    "Jam tertinggi: " + ", ".join(
        f"**{int(h):02d}:00** ({r:.2%})"
        for h, r in zip(top3["transaction_hour"], top3["rate"])),
    f"{int((g['lo'] > baseline).sum())} dari 24 jam punya batas bawah CI "
    "di atas baseline.",
)
```
:::
::: {.notes}
- Hari dalam seminggu tidak ditampilkan (volume rata, kemungkinan noise)

## Fraud Rate by Merchant Country
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
g = rate_table(df, "merchant_country")
plot_rate(g, "merchant_country", "Fraud Rate by Merchant Country",
          figsize=(7, 5), fs=8)
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
s = g.sort_values("rate")
top, low = s.iloc[-1], s.iloc[0]
bullets(
    f"Tertinggi: **{top['merchant_country']}** {top['rate']:.2%} "
    f"(lift {top['lift']:.2f}x).",
    f"Terendah: **{low['merchant_country']}** {low['rate']:.2%}.",
    f"{int((g['lo'] > baseline).sum())} dari {len(g)} negara punya CI "
    "di atas baseline.",
)
```
:::
::: {.notes}
- Negara kecil punya CI lebar, baca dengan hati-hati

## Fraud Type: Cases vs Loss
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{python}
ft = (fraud_data.groupby("fraud_type")["fraud_amount_lost"]
      .agg(n="size", total="sum")
      .sort_values("total", ascending=False))
ft["share_n"] = ft["n"] / ft["n"].sum()
ft["share_loss"] = ft["total"] / ft["total"].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ft[["share_n", "share_loss"]].plot.barh(
    ax=ax, color=["#4C72B0", "#C44E52"])
ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1, decimals=0))
ax.set_title("Share of Cases vs Share of Loss")
ax.set_xlabel("Share")
ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.legend(["Cases", "Loss"], frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
```{python}
#| output: asis
t = ft.index[0]
bullets(
    f"Penyumbang kerugian terbesar: **{t}** "
    f"({ft.loc[t, 'share_loss']:.1%} loss, "
    f"{ft.loc[t, 'share_n']:.1%} kasus).",
    "Jumlah kasus terbanyak belum tentu kerugian terbesar.",
)
```
